$comment: Review-lanes manifest (ADR-0011 decision A, #2869). A lane is a named row
here and nowhere else: this file is the only place an endpoint, a
credential binding, an egress host, a model policy or a cost basis for the
dogfood AI review may be defined. No workflow expression derives any of
them from the vars context, and no variable at any scope selects a lane.
chain is the only routing input: chain[0] is the active lane, the rest is
the fallback order of decision D. Switching lanes is a reviewed one-line
diff to chain. scripts/ci/resolve_review_lanes.py validates this file and
fails closed before any secret is exposed.
credential_env / credential_source_env name environment VARIABLES the
workflow injects a repository secret into; nothing in this file is a
secret. A file-form credential is materialised by the wrapper at
credential_file from credential_source_env for the length of one attempt.
base_url_env is the provider override the CLI reads; null means the CLI
reads none, and the lane endpoint must then be the CLI's built-in one.
priced_models lists the models lintro carries a non-zero list-price table
for (tests/scripts/ci/test_resolve_review_lanes.py pins it to the
registry); a row whose default or allowed model is not in it must declare
shadow_price_model, as must every non-first-party row (decision B).
Owner decision 2026-10-13: zai-glm-gateway stays declared as an explicit
opt-in lane; it becomes active only by a merged diff placing it first.
